subject: Chemistry
chapter: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
title: Organic Chemistry: Chapter Introduction
summary: Paracetamol, plastic, cotton and DNA share one element: carbon. Why carbon forms millions of compounds, and what this chapter teaches.
keyPoints: **Organic chemistry** is the chemistry of carbon compounds: medicines, plastics, cotton and DNA are all examples.
Carbon compounds number in the **millions**, so they have a whole branch of chemistry.
Carbon forms **4 covalent bonds** (tetravalency); methane, CH₄, is tetrahedral.
**Catenation:** carbon atoms bond to each other to form long chains and rings.
This chapter teaches how to **draw and name** molecules, how **electrons move** in reactions, and how to **purify and analyse** compounds.
